items.quote: When organizing events, Bonfiire has been an amazing app to bring people together. The minimalistic layout has been easy to navigate and has helped us minimize our workload.
items.name: Christian Ripi

items.quote: Bonfiire made our Banana Carnival Appro so much easier to run. Everything from collecting points to tracking winners happened in the app, saving our board a lot of time and hassle.
items.name: Mishal Amran
